info.text:
A no-spend month isn't really about saving. It's an X-ray.

A no-spend challenge pauses non-essential spending for a set period; rent, bills and groceries still get paid.
In 2024, the average US consumer unit spent $3,945 on food away from home (BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey).
In a 2022 C+R Research survey, people guessed $86 a month on subscriptions; itemized, it was $219, and 42% had forgotten one they still paid for.
Prelec and Loewenstein (1998) described the 'pain of paying'; later research (Prelec & Simester, 2001) found card payments can soften it. Example: three $15 takeout orders a week for four weeks = $180.

Sources: BLS, C+R Research, Prelec & Loewenstein (Marketing Science, 1998), Prelec & Simester (Marketing Letters, 2001).
News and education, not financial advice.
